subject: errors on plot ancestral states - DEC

messages.author: 47a15dd83b28d95b
messages.subject: errors on plot ancestral states - DEC
parts:
Hi

My DEC analysis appears to run fine but when I come to plot I get the following error messages:

> # States
> res2 = plot_BioGeoBEARS_results(results_object, analysis_titletxt, addl_params=list("j"), plotwhat="text", label.offset=0.45, tipcex=0.7, statecex=0.7, splitcex
Error in .C("node_height", as.integer(Ntip), as.integer(Nnode), as.integer(edge[,  : RUE, tr=tr, tipranges=tipranges)
  Incorrect number of arguments (6), expecting 4 for 'node_height'
>
> # Pie chart
> plot_BioGeoBEARS_results(results_object, analysis_titletxt, addl_params=list("j"), plotwhat="pie", label.offset=0.45, tipcex=0.7, statecex=0.7, splitcex=0.6, ti
Error in .C("node_height", as.integer(Ntip), as.integer(Nnode), as.integer(edge[,  : tr, tipranges=tipranges)
  Incorrect number of arguments (6), expecting 4 for 'node_height'

The PDF plot is actually outputted no problem and looks complete - is this something to be concerned about?

Not sure if it relates to the warning at the bottom of my DEC job run report:

Warning message:
In (function (npt = min(n + 2L, 2L * n), rhobeg = NA, rhoend = NA,  :
  unused control arguments ignored

I've attached my tree & geog data just in case

Many thanks

Clive

messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] errors on plot ancestral states - DEC
parts:
Hi!  I think this is the issue with the new version of APE, the BioGeoBEARS code was revised a bit to use the old behavior when ape version was <5.0.  So, make sure you use the source() commands after any use of library(BioGeoBEARS).  See this previous thread:

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/biogeobears/ape$205.0%7Csort:date/biogeobears/gQ4bZ4U3FU8/IuIxh7_qCAAJ

If that doesn't fix it, let me know, it's possible they changed something else in APE, as I've noticed weird phylogeny plotting behavior in general (outside of BioGeoBEARS) since upgrading ape to version 5.0.

Cheers,
Nick
